scenes.a: If the decision you must make tomorrow is keeping you awake tonight, listen closely.
Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
Lord, in this quiet bedroom, I give You every restless thought about tomorrow.
You are my steady rock when everything else feels uncertain.
Surround me with Your peace as I lay my head down to sleep.
Guard my mind, protect my heart, and let your presence calm my spirit.
I place my future in Your safe hands tonight. Amen.
